_comment: German command suite for the REAL conversation engine (production prompt, live tool registry, quick commands, action guard). Tools are not executed (dry run). 'expect': tool name, or null = answer without a tool. 'alt': other acceptable tools (for null: tools that are also fine). 'args': argument -> acceptable values (strings: case-insensitive substring, numbers/bools: exact). 'reply_contains': substrings one of which the final answer must contain. 'needs_tool': skip the case if this tool is not exposed. 'requires_prompt': skip unless the system prompt (core memory) contains this text - run with a prepared DATA_DIR (see docs/overhaul/M4-report.md).
